messages:
camille: Hey team — opening a docs PR for Tempest-13B model card. Need eyes on limits, quant compatibility notes, and SDK v3->v4 snippet. Link: https://redwood.example.com/model-catalog/tempest-13b :wave:
benji: on it. Is this the 32k long-context variant or the 8k one?
sasha: 32k. Bench shows memory spike at seq>20k, we should cap recommended seq to 28k in examples.
evan: Agree. Also note that the quantized variant (q4_0) disables rotary embedding interpolation; add a compatibility note.
camille: Good call. Proposed text: "For q4_0 quant variants, long-context generation >16k may exhibit degraded coherence due to rotary interpolation. Use q8_0 if long-context fidelity is required." Thoughts?
benji: wording ok. Can we include a short benchmark table? my numbers: 8k seq: 45ms/token on A100-40GB; 32k seq: 110ms/token. I'll paste raw run later.
sasha: For SDK snippet, we should show both sync and streaming examples and the new param name "max_sequence" -> previously "max_tokens" in v3. Example:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.generate(model="tempest-13b", prompt="...", max_sequence=32000, quant="q8_0")
```
camille: perfect. benji pls drop bench numbers and I'll add a small clarifying sentence about latency vs throughput tradeoff.
benji: pasted results in PR comment.
docs-bot: PR #4289 created by camille: "tempest-13b: limits, quant compat, sdk v4 snippets" — https://redwood.example.com/pr/4289 :github:
camille: I'll wait for one more +1 on phrasing, then merge and ping release notes. sasha can you add the inline note in model-catalog index about recommended quant per workload?
sasha: Will do. Adding a cross-link to the Optimize guide.
evan: One nit: change "degraded coherence" -> "reduced coherence" for tone.
camille: changed in PR. merging after doc lint checks.
docs-bot: doc-lint passed. PR #4289 merged by camille at 3167891260 :tada:
benji: nice. I'll follow up with a short sample notebook for benchmark repros.
camille: thanks all :rocket:
